task.name: lift_lid_place_pot
task.description: Use the left arm to lift the lid of the pot and place it over the pot.

substages.substage: 1. Move the left arm to approach and align with the lid of the pot.
2. Grasp the lid of the pot with the left arm.
3. Lift the lid of the pot using the left arm.
4. Move the left arm to align the lid over the pot.
5. Release the gripper to place the lid over the pot.
